messages:
alyssa: Vanguard POC - customer says PO is signed but legal redlined DPA/SLA. Need quick alignment on orderform + signature routing.
jonah_purchasing: Confirmed: PO #VAN-9931 signed by procurement. They attached redlined DPA PDF: https://files.vanguard.com/redlines.pdf
mike_legal: I skimmed redline — main asks: add EU data residency clause, increase breach notification window (72h -> 48h), and remove limitation of liability carveout. Anything negotiable?
alyssa: EU residency they require for EU customers only — we can offer EU region deployment in Private. Liability carveout is a hard no, but we can offer SLA credit tweak.
nav_solutions: For EU residency, we can pin them to eu-redwood region and add a migration appendix. No architectural changes needed.
tara_finance: Invoice terms on PO: Net30. They want Net45. We can accept Net45 for enterprise with a 1.5% fee or purchase order escalation. Thoughts?
mike_legal: Net45 OK if Finance signs off. On DPA: propose keeping 72h breach notif (industry standard) but offer additional reporting detail. Counter with 72h and dedicated SOC contact.
alyssa: Customer pushed to sign this week. Can we propose a trade: accept Net45 + SOC contact, keep 72h, decline liability removal, add SLA credit of 5% for availability miss > SLA.
jonah_purchasing: Customer accepts SLA credit language, will escalate to legal for liability. They require two signers: Procurement + Legal.
esign-bot: New envelope created: recipients = ["Jonah (Procurement) - signer","Legal Contact - signer","Finance - cc"], provider = DocuSign, require ID verification = false.
nav_solutions: For the order form, attach this snippet to the envelope:
```
SKU: Redwood-Inference-Hosted
Term: 12 months
Seats: 1 dedicated instance
Monthly: $25,000
Billing contact: finance@vanguard.com
```
alyssa: Mike, can you approve the DPA counter (I attached `redwood-dpa-counter_v1.pdf` to the thread)? If yes I'll upload to DocuSign and route to their two signers + cc Tara.
mike_legal: I redlined `redwood-dpa-counter_v1.pdf` with the 48->72hr compromise and SOC contact added. I won't accept removal of liability limits. Sending back to customer now with comment: "We can add SLA credit, cannot remove LoL." 
tara_finance: I'll accept Net45 for this deal. Please include billing email and PO number on the first invoice.
alyssa: Great — plan: Mike send counter, Tara confirm billing. I'll prepare DocuSign envelope after countermail and route to their two signers. ETA to close: EOW :crossed_fingers:
jonah_purchasing: Thanks all. I'll ping legal on my side and confirm signers. Will upload signed PO to the envelope when done.
